document.description: Canadian permanent resident card: verified visitor visa exemptions for Mexico, Belize, the Dominican Republic, Georgia, the Cayman Islands and the Turks and Caicos Islands. This is a partial destination list.

unlocks.conditions: Present a valid passport or travel document and proof of permanent residence in Canada for tourism, business or other non-remunerated visitor activities. Temporary residence is not covered by this exemption.

source.verificationPath: INM > Paises y regiones que requieren visa para viajar a Mexico > RECUERDA QUE > alternative documents, item a)
source.exactQuote: Documento que acredite residencia permanente en Canadá

unlocks.notes: 180 days is the maximum, not a guaranteed grant. Immigration authorities assess the purpose of travel and may request supporting documents. This entry does not authorize paid work or residence.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a valid Canadian Permanent Residence Card. The entry-visa exemption applies to visits not exceeding 30 days.

source.verificationPath: Belize Immigration > Visa > Do You Need a Visa to Visit Belize > exemption list, Canada bullet
source.exactQuote: valid multiple entry visa or Permanent Residence Card from Canada

unlocks.notes: This entry records the permanent-residence-card route, separately from the Canadian visa route. A longer stay requires an Immigration Office extension; it is not included in the 30-day exemption.

unlocks.conditions: Hold valid permanent residence in Canada and a valid passport. Entry without a Dominican visa is for tourism using a Tourist Card; temporary residence and work or study are not covered by this entry.

source.verificationPath: MIREX > Portal Unico de Servicios > Visas > Decreto Num. 691-07
source.exactQuote: extranjeros con residencia permanente o visado de entradas múltiples vigente en Estados Unidos, Unión Europea (Schengen), Canadá o Gran Bretaña.

staySource.verificationPath: DGII > Tarjeta de Turista > Sobre Tarjeta de Turista
staySource.exactQuote: La Tarjeta de Turista autoriza a los visitantes a permanecer en el país por un período máximo de 30 días.

unlocks.notes: This records Canadian permanent residence separately from the Canadian visa exemption. The Tourist Card is an entry tax, not a visa on arrival; DGII says it is included in air tickets issued outside the Dominican Republic. The 30-day stay does not include any extension and does not authorize work, study or residence. Other immigration entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Hold a Canadian permanent resident card valid on the day of entry into Georgia and present the travel and/or other appropriate document proving its validity. Visa-free stays are limited to 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.

source.verificationPath: Legislative Herald of Georgia > Ordinance No 256 of 5 June 2015 > annex, Canada (item 22), and Notes 1-2
source.exactQuote: Aliens holding a visa and/or a residence permit of any country listed in the annex may enter and stay in Georgia without visa for 90 calendar days in any 180-day period.
source.validityQuote: For the purpose of entering and staying in Georgia without visa, a visa and/or a residence permit of a respective country shall be valid on the day of entry into Georgia (crossing the border), which must be evidenced by a travel and/or other appropriate document.
source.notes: The English page is the initial edition. Checked against the MFA-hosted Georgian consolidated text and the listed 17 April 2025 amendment; that amendment adds conditions for specified Gulf-state documents, not Canadian residence permits.

currentTextSource.verificationPath: MFA legal-act PDF > page 2, Canada (item 22); page 3, entry conditions 1-3

unlocks.notes: This entry covers Canadian permanent residence, separately from the Canadian visa route. The 90-day allowance is cumulative within any 180 days, not a fresh 90 days per entry. It does not establish permission to work, study or reside in Georgia; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Be resident in Canada, arrive directly from Canada or the United States, present proof of Canadian permanent residence or landed immigrant status, and present a return or round-trip ticket to Canada or the United States. The exemption is subject to the traveller not being a prohibited immigrant.

source.verificationPath: Cayman Islands Government > Customs & Border Control > Visitor Visa > List of Countries - Visa Required > Exemptions
source.exactQuote: you are resident in Canada; and you arrive directly from Canada or the USA; and you produce on arrival proof that you are a permanent resident or landed immigrant of Canada; and you produce on arrival a return or round trip ticket to Canada or the United States.
source.stayQuote: persons taking advantage of the waiver of the visa requirement above may only be permitted to enter and remain in the Islands for a period not exceeding thirty days.

unlocks.notes: The 30-day period is the maximum permitted under this visa waiver, not a guaranteed grant of admission. The traveller must arrive directly from Canada or the United States and hold a return or round-trip ticket to one of those countries. This exemption does not authorize work or residence; other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Be a lawful resident of Canada, present a valid passport, and present evidence of Canadian residence. The visa exemption does not guarantee admission; a Border Force officer determines entry on arrival.

source.verificationPath: Turks and Caicos Islands Border Force > Entry Requirements > Visa-required travellers
source.exactQuote: if you are a lawful resident of the United Kingdom, United States of America, or Canada
source.admissionQuote: A Border Force Officer will determine whether you can enter TCI when you arrive.

staySource.verificationPath: GOV.UK > Turks and Caicos Islands travel advice > Entry requirements > Visa requirements
staySource.exactQuote: On arrival, the immigration department will normally give you permission to stay for up to 90 days.

unlocks.notes: This entry records lawful Canadian residence, including permanent residence, separately from the valid Canadian visa route. The current GOV.UK travel advice states that immigration normally grants up to 90 days; the period actually granted and admission remain subject to Border Force. This exemption does not authorize work or residence, and other entry requirements still apply.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid permanent residence issued by Canada are exempt from visa requirements when entering Panama as tourists.

source.verificationPath: Servicio Nacional de Migración Panamá > Decreto Ejecutivo N° 521 de 2003 > Artículo 1
source.exactQuote: Se suprime el requisito de visa a los nacionales de los países que a continuación se indican, siempre que posean visa válida o residencia válida expedida por los Estados Unidos de América, Canadá, Australia, Reino Unido, Japón o por cualquiera de los Estados miembros de la Unión Europea: Andorra, Antigua y Barbuda, Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Belice, Brasil, Brunei Darussalam, Chile, Corea del Sur, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Granada, Guatemala, Honduras, Israel, Macedonia del Norte, Malasia, Mónaco, Nicaragua, Paraguay, Perú, San Cristóbal y Nieves, San Vicente y las Granadinas, Santa Lucía, Singapur, Taiwán, Trinidad y Tobago, Uruguay, Venezuela.

unlocks.notes: Holders of valid permanent residence issued by Canada are exempt.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid permanent residence in Canada may be exempt from visa requirements under certain conditions.

source.verificationPath: Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería de Costa Rica > Visa requirements
source.exactQuote: Extranjeros con residencia permanente o visa vigente de Estados Unidos, Canadá o países miembros de la Unión Europea.

unlocks.notes: Holders of valid permanent residence in Canada are exempt from visa requirements.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid permanent residence in Canada may enter visa-free for tourism purposes.

source.verificationPath: Gobierno del Perú > Migraciones > Visa requirements
source.exactQuote: Extranjeros con residencia permanente vigente en Estados Unidos, Canadá, Reino Unido o países Schengen.

unlocks.notes: Holders of valid Canadian permanent residence may enter without a visa.

unlocks.conditions: Holders of valid permanent residence in Canada are exempt from tourist visa requirements.

source.verificationPath: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Colombia > Visa requirements
source.exactQuote: Ciudadanos extranjeros con visa o residencia permanente vigente de Canadá, Estados Unidos, Reino Unido o países Schengen no requieren visa para turismo.

unlocks.notes: Holders of valid Canadian permanent residence are exempt.
